title: STOCK FOOTAGE OF KOREA Seoul, Korea
producer: U.S. Navy, Pacific Fleet Combat Camera Group (slate: cameraman T.K. Reynolds, 'Stock footage Seoul, ROK', 7 Nov 69); NARA RG 428 series 'Moving Images Relating to Military Activities', creator Naval Photographic Center
contents: Shot list 9–21: farm girls separating rice from chaff, farmers using a foot-pedal threshing machine by straw-roofed buildings, revolving drum, faces, bamboo rakes, woman with a baby strapped to her back, flail threshing. The village is not named in the catalog.
encode: H.264 CRF 20 (preset slow), 30 fps, yuv420p, +faststart; the film is silent (NARA soundType Silent / no checked soundtrack), audio track replaced with digital silence
licence: US federal government work (17 U.S.C. §105), filmed by US military personnel on duty; NARA use restriction is not 'Restricted'. Over 50 years old.
